oimr.options.host_only_tooltip: Only th' Captain o' this ship or th' portmaster's log can alter these articles.
oimr.settings.title: One Inventory, Many Regrets
oimr.settings.slots_duplication_warning: Ahoy, warnin': Unlinkin' cargo slots can conjure twin loot (intended magic).
Leavin' any belt slot or gear slot unshared keeps each sailor's booty separate an' can actively conjure twin items when crewmates board, swap crews, or shift loot. This be planned shipwright behavior.
oimr.warning.affinity_reset: [OIMR] Foul affinity value spotted in th' ship's ledger (> 100%% or crooked); affinity was set back t' 100%%.
oimr.settings.affinity.tooltip: Steers how strongly potions, healin', knockback, wounds, an' Respiration be shared. At 100%%, all crewmate dooms be bound together; below 100%% breaks mandatory chain-dooms (e.g. at 50%%, 10 damage t' A deals 5 t' crewmates). Leaves shared cargo slots untouched.
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.n: Wounds for 1 crew heart: none (0%% affinity)
oimr.settings.affinity.heart_indicator.t: Shows how much hurt one sailor must take (2 HP = 1 heart) for crewmates t' suffer 1 full heart (2 HP) o' shared wounds.
oimr.settings.hunger_weight.tooltip: Per-sailor belly drain multiplier: (Weight * Action) / PartySize.
oimr.settings.xp_weight.tooltip: Per-sailor experience haul multiplier: (Weight * XP) / PartySize. Spendin' XP (witchery tables, slabs o' fixin') stays unchanged.
oimr.settings.sync_hotbar.tooltip: When Aye, all 9 belt slots (includin' yer sword hand) be shared across th' whole crew.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.tooltip: When Belt sharin' be Nay, shares Belt Slot 1 as a crew main-hand slot.
oimr.settings.sync_main_hand.coupled_too: Governed by Share Belt whilst Belt sharin' be Aye (main hand uses th' drawn belt slot).
oimr.settings.sync_off_hand.tooltip: Shares th' offhand slot across all crewmates.
oimr.settings.sync_helmet.tooltip: Shares th' helm armor slot across all crewmates.
oimr.settings.sync_chestplate.tooltip: Shares th' chestplate armor slot across all crewmates.
oimr.settings.sync_leggings.tooltip: Shares th' leggings armor slot across all crewmates.
oimr.settings.sync_boots.tooltip: Shares th' boots armor slot across all crewmates.
oimr.settings.shared_knockback.tooltip: Sends knockback across th' crew (scaled by Affinity) an' gives opposite recoil when slappin' a crewmate.
oimr.settings.friendly_pets.tooltip: Stops tamed or trusted sea-dogs an' critters o' crewmates from bitin' fellow sailors.
oimr.settings.exclude_creative.tooltip: When Aye, crewmates in Aimless sailin' mode be spared from 100%% Affinity cascade doom.
oimr.settings.wipe_creative.tooltip: When Aimless sailin' crewmates survive cascade doom, still plunder shared cargo, gear, an' XP.
oimr.settings.comunism.tooltip: Shows a merry equal-rations jest when th' crew perishes o' scurvy starvation.
oimr.settings.shared_ender_pearl.tooltip: Warps th' entire crew t' th' landin' spot whenever any matey throws a Pearl o' ender.
oimr.settings.shared_portals.tooltip: Sails th' whole crew together whenever any matey steps through a Nether or End Portal.
oimr.settings.underwater_muffle.tooltip: Puts a deep-sea muffled sound filter on yer ears whenever ye or a bonded crewmate be beneath th' waves.
oimr.settings.shared_mob_sounds.tooltip: Echoes beast sounds heard by crewmates with 1/N odds (N = crew size), true compass direction toward th' beast, matched range, an' loudness scaled by Affinity.
